apple-airpods-4-with-active-noise-cancel: Loved for very comfortable wear and good sound; some say noise cancelling is not perfect.
apple-airpods-pro-2: Liked as an easy everyday earbud with strong noise cancelling; some find they slip out in workouts.
apple-airpods-pro-3: Praised for standout noise cancelling and a secure fit; some feel pressure or looseness.
bose-quietcomfort-ultra-earbuds-2nd-gen: Rated for the best noise cancelling many have used; a few had ear pain or weak cancelling.
bowers-wilkins-pi8: Loved for clear, spacious sound and good comfort; some report connection or charging problems.
dunu-kima-2: Liked for warm, natural tuning with standout vocals; a few find the treble bright or rolled off.
focal-bathys-mg: Praised for detailed, spacious sound and plush comfort; a few report build and finish problems.
hifiman-arya-organic: Loved for resolution, big soundstage and value; some find the bright treble sibilant or fatiguing.
hifiman-arya-stealth: Praised for a huge soundstage, imaging and detail; several report dead or failing drivers.
hifiman-edition-xs: Loved as outstanding value with a wide, open soundstage; some report rattling or dying drivers.
hifiman-sundara: Loved for detailed, balanced sound at good value; many report dead or buzzing drivers.
kiwi-ears-astral: Liked for clean, detailed sound and sharp imaging; the large shell hurts some ears after hours.
kz-duonic: Praised as crisp, detailed sound for very little money; a few find the short nozzle will not stay in.
kz-prx: Liked as a cheap way into planar sound with strong clarity; some want EQ or a better cable.
letshuoer-astralis: Liked as a warm, fun planar with strong bass and smooth treble; a few find it less technical.
letshuoer-s12-pro: Praised for clear, detailed, energetic sound; the short, angled nozzle is hard to seal for some.
letshuoer-s12-ultra: Loved for detailed planar sound with fast bass and smooth treble; a few found the soundstage flat.
meze-109-pro: Loved for comfort, solid build and warm, punchy sound; some find the treble a touch bright.
meze-alba: Praised for tiny, light comfort over long hours; some find the sound thin or bass-light.
moondrop-old-fashioned: Liked as a cheap, light, comfortable open-back with clear sound; many find the bass thin.
moondrop-space-travel-2: Liked for its sound and low cost; some report fit, case or battery problems.
sennheiser-hd-600: Loved for natural, smooth mids and long-session ease; a good number find the clamp strong.
sennheiser-hd-650: Loved for a warm, smooth midrange kept for years; a few find it dull or veiled.
sennheiser-hd-800-s: Loved for an expansive soundstage and imaging; the common complaint is thin or lacking bass.
sennheiser-momentum-true-wireless-5: Rated highly for sound and noise cancelling; few real complaints.
simgot-ew300: Liked as a detailed, comfortable all-rounder at a low price; some find the treble sharp.
sony-linkbuds-s: Liked as light, well built and decent at noise cancelling; a couple report battery problems.
sony-wf-1000xm6: Praised for standout noise cancelling and good sound; some find the buds fall out.
thieaudio-monarch-mkiv: Loved for detailed, clean sound with strong bass; many find the large shells painful in long sessions.
